item.description: Mexico is no longer the country with the greatest prevalence of child obesity, but being No. 8 is no cause for celebration, experts warn. item.title: New anti-femicide law seeks expanded definition and increased prison time: Tuesday’s mañanera recapped
item.description: The proposed law would require all Attorney General's offices in Mexico to investigate every violent death of a woman or girl under the femicide hypothesis and would increase the maximum prison time from 60 years to 70 years. item.description: The publication of the inflation data for the first half of the month comes just two days before the Bank of Mexico (Banxico) board will decide whether to cut, maintain or increase the central bank's benchmark interest rate, which is currently set at 7%.
